free_tier_limits.correction: By default, up to 200 requests per month and 50 requests per day; limits depend on account type and plan. Free API access is restricted to qualifying open-data projects under share-alike attribution terms.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits are 200 requests per month and 50 requests per day by default, with account- and plan-specific limits.

notes: The API is operational; HTTP 401 at the versioned base is consistent with mandatory API-token authentication. The submitted documentation URL uses an obsolete underscore and returns 404. The official reference publishes quotas, contradicting both unknown free-tier limits and not-published rate limits.
